description: I’m proud to announce that I have received the endorsement of the Center for Freethought Equality PAC.This organization works to protect the constitutional principle of separation of church and state and supports candidates committed to evidence-based policies that treat all Ohioans fairly — regardless of religious belief or nonbelief.I am honored by their support. This endorsement reinforces my commitment to equality, science-based solutions, bodily autonomy, and LGBTQ+ rights. In District 84,
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Arienne Childrey
title: Exciting News: I’ve Been Endorsed by the Center for Freethought Equality PAC
